## Checklist (Definition of Done, Doc 03 §9.5)

- [ ] CI is green (lint, typecheck, tests, build)
- [ ] Engine changes include tests
- [ ] New constants have a `sourceId` (REF) or a `gameNote` explaining the simplification (GAME)
- [ ] UI checked at 1280×720 and 768 px wide, keyboard only, no console errors
- [ ] Copy reviewed for reading age 11–12
- [ ] Screenshots attached for UI changes
